function.name: find_purchase_order
function.description: Find the purchase order the invoice bills. Full-text search covers PO number, supplier name, item SKU, invoice number, and tracking number; filter[invoice_status] narrows to uninvoiced/partial/invoiced POs. (GET /api/purchase-orders)

search.description: Search by the PO number printed on the invoice, or by supplier name. Narrow to a single PO before invoicing against it.

filter[invoice_status].description: Filter by invoice status: uninvoiced, partial, invoiced.

filter[order_status].description: Filter by order status: draft, open, closed. Invoices are recorded against non-draft POs.

function.name: get_purchase_order
function.description: Get the full PO with all relations — lines, existing invoices, and financial_lines (each with its id). Needed when the invoice bills freight/fees: invoice financial_lines must reference an existing PO financial line id. (GET /api/purchase-orders/{purchase_order})

function.name: get_po_lines_for_invoice
function.description: Get the PO's lines optimized for invoice creation — each line's id (the purchase_order_line_id an invoice line references), product_id, description, quantity, received_quantity, amount (PO unit cost), and discount_rate. (GET /api/purchase-orders/{purchase_order}/lines-for-invoice)

function.name: check_existing_invoices
function.description: List purchase invoices — use before creating to catch a duplicate (same supplier invoice number) and to see what is already invoiced on the PO. filter[...] fields support operators like .is and .contains. (GET /api/purchase-invoices)

filter[supplier_invoice_number].description: Filter by the supplier's invoice number (text match) — the duplicate check.

filter[purchase_order_id].description: Filter to invoices already recorded against a PO (exact match).

filter[search].description: Search across supplier_invoice_number, id, supplier name, purchase_order_number.

function.name: create_purchase_invoice
function.description: Create the purchase invoice linked to a purchase order. Either purchase_invoice_lines or financial_lines must be provided; invoice lines must belong to the PO and must not be fully invoiced. (POST /api/purchase-invoices)

purchase_order_id.description: The purchase order this invoice bills (from find-purchase-order).

supplier_invoice_number.description: The supplier's own invoice number, exactly as printed on the document.

purchase_invoice_date.description: The invoice date printed on the document (ISO-8601). Always pass it.

due_date.description: Payment due date — from the document, or invoice date + the terms' net days.

status.description: Invoice status on creation — use "open". Payment states (partial, paid) are reached by recording payments, not by setting them here.

currency_id.description: Currency id — omit to use the PO's currency. Only set when the invoice is genuinely in a different currency, and resolve the id first (don't guess).

currency_rate.description: Conversion rate to the account base currency, when overriding currency.

tags.description: Array of string tags for filtering/reporting.

purchase_invoice_lines.description: Product lines. Each: { purchase_order_line_id (from get-po-lines-for-invoice), quantity_invoiced (must not exceed the line's uninvoiced remainder), unit_price (what the invoice actually charges, not the PO price) }. Required unless financial_lines is provided.

financial_lines.description: Non-product charges being invoiced (freight, duties, fees). Each requires: id (an EXISTING financial line id from get-purchase-order — a 422 is returned if missing), quantity, amount; link_type optional. Required unless purchase_invoice_lines is provided.

function.name: attach_document
function.description: Upload the source invoice document to the recorded invoice as multipart/form-data. PDF, DOC/DOCX, PNG, JPG up to 20 MB. If the account has Invoice OCR auto-scan enabled a PDF is queued for OCR; if the invoice is synced to QuickBooks/Xero the file is forwarded there. (POST /api/purchase-invoices/{purchaseInvoice}/attachments)

file.description: The file to attach (multipart form field).

category.description: Document category: invoice, payment_proof, or other (default). Use "invoice" for the source document.

function.name: three_way_match
function.description: Verify the recorded invoice: per-PO-line comparison of ordered vs received vs invoiced quantities (qty_match_status: match, over_invoiced, under_invoiced — evaluated across all invoices and credits on the PO) and unit-price variance vs the PO. (GET /api/purchase-invoices/{purchaseInvoice}/three-way-match)

function.name: list_payment_types
function.description: List the account's payment types (id, name — e.g. Bank Transfer, Credit Card) to resolve payment_type_id before recording a payment. Scope settings:read. (GET /api/v2/payment-types)

function.name: record_payment
function.description: Record a payment that has already been made against the invoice. Amount must not exceed the remaining balance; negative amounts record refunds. Only records the fact — it moves no money. (POST /api/purchase-invoices/{purchaseInvoiceId}/payments)

payment_type_id.description: Payment type id (from list-payment-types). Don't invent it.

amount.description: Amount paid, in the invoice currency. Must not exceed the remaining balance.

payment_date.description: Date the payment was made (ISO-8601). Defaults to today if omitted.

currency_id.description: Currency id — omit to use the invoice's currency.
